title: SuperTsunami
description: Makes water and lava from buckets spread rapidly and infinitely, causing instant flooding.
body:
**SuperTsunami** allows you to create massive, infinite floods using water, lava, and 
powder snow buckets. Watch the liquid automatically expand horizontally across your world!


![GIF](https://i.imgur.com/hcZzkxw.gif)
---

## ⚙️ Requirements
- Java 21 or higher is required.

---

## ✨ Features
- **Three liquid types:** 🌊 Water, 🔥 Lava, and ❄️ Powder Snow buckets all trigger a tsunami.
- **Configurable speed** — set spread delay individually for each liquid type.
- **Radius limit** — cap how far a flood can spread from its origin.
- **Block whitelist** — protect specific blocks from ever being replaced (bedrock, obsidian, barriers, etc.).
- **Replaceable blocks** — optionally make the wave sweep away grass, flowers, and other plants.
- **Admin commands** — reload config live or stop all active floods instantly.
- **Simple Mechanics** — no setup needed, just use a vanilla bucket.

---

## 📖 How to Use
1. Fly up or build a pillar — the liquid needs open space to spread.
2. Make sure to place the liquid **at least 3 blocks above the ground**.  
   *(If placed directly on the ground, the spread may be blocked by terrain.)*
3. Right-click with a Water, Lava, or Powder Snow bucket.
4. Watch the wave expand infinitely!

### Commands (op only)
| Command | Action |
|---|---|
| `/tsunami reload` | Reload `config.yml` without restarting |
| `/tsunami stop` | Instantly cancel all active tsunamis |

---

## ⚠️ WARNING
**Use with caution!** This plugin creates an infinite loop of block updates.
- **Do not** use this on a production server with important builds unless you have backups.
- It can cause **severe lag** or server crashes if the liquid spreads into too many unloaded chunks.
- Use `max-radius` in the config to keep things under control.
